column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: Sodom's Industry and Workers
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: What do you think? This building is enormous!
No other city has the skill to build anything like it.
We are building an inn here. Everyone is working hard, aren't they?
That is because we do not care about birth or the color of one's $$羽$$,
and entrust important work to capable people!!
This factory supports the city's industries; it has a rotary iron-smelting furnace.
Thanks to it, we can produce iron in bulk with many times the old strength.
And because of that, look at the remarkable modern textile mill next door!
It is fully automated, using steam that rises from the earth to turn pulleys!
Even I, with white $$羽$$, can choose the work I like and labor in $$自由$$ here!
Until I came to this city, I was treated as a $$奴隷$$...
No matter how hard I worked in my old city, my $$ご主人様$$ took all my income.
But in Sodom, the work I do is promised a corresponding income...
No one takes away my earnings for no reason merely because I have white $$羽$$.
It is like a dream!!
This city is splendid, isn't it? It proves how hard we have worked!
We learned that when we work together, regardless of the color of our $$羽$$,
the city can become this splendid!
Here, the color of your $$羽$$ does not matter!
Income is guaranteed according to your work.
There is as much work as anyone could seek,
so frankly, anyone who refuses to work in this city is trash!!
$$スタン$$ the $$領主$$ was the hardest worker in the city.
That is why he was chosen as $$領主$$!!
You people...
You must be wanted $$逃亡奴隷$$s, aren't you?!
$$救世主$$s, welcome back so soon.
Now then, what decision will these so-called $$救世主$$s make...?
